name: fabzter-agent-skills
description: Agent-neutral skills shared across coding agents (omp, Claude Code, Codex, Devin, Hermes, OpenClaw, Qwen, Qoder)

plugins.name: token-plan-multimodal-gen
plugins.description: Generate images, speech (TTS), and video through Alibaba Model Studio Token Plan via DashScope-native endpoints.

plugins.name: chrome-relay-live-tab
plugins.description: Drive the user's live, logged-in Chrome tabs through the omp browser relay's raw CDP endpoint.

plugins.name: ladybug-memory-runbook
plugins.description: Diagnose and repair Ladybug graph-memory failures: 'database is not initialised', corrupt WAL, SIGBUS crashes, and multi-process single-writer corruption.

plugins.name: ats-form-filling
plugins.description: Fill job application forms (Workday, Greenhouse) in the user's live logged-in Chrome tab via the CDP relay, sourced from the CV.

plugins.name: gog-oauth-refresh-token-expiry
plugins.description: Diagnose and fix gog CLI logins that expire every ~7 days (Google External+Testing 7-day refresh tokens); detect via refresh_token_expires_in, fix by publishing the OAuth app + force-consent re-auth.

plugins.name: personal-vault-para
plugins.description: Personal Obsidian PARA conventions, research snapshots and a deterministic conflict-aware governance sync.

plugins.name: macos-sdl3-gamepad-rumble
plugins.description: Gamepad not detected or rumble silent/collapsing FPS on macOS in an SDL3 app: layer triage (OS HID, GameController, SDL, TCC Input Monitoring), the DS4 Bluetooth HID report convention SDL cannot express, stop-frame discipline, and moving synchronous HID writes off the frame loop.

plugins.name: psxrecomp-gamepad-rumble
plugins.description: Controllers or rumble broken in a psxrecomp game port (BloodyRoar2Recomp, MGS recomp family): SIO trace, digital-vs-DualShock config gate, forwarder hold/stop policy, per-region setup wizard configs, and the submodule patch workflow.

plugins.name: psxrecomp-macos-overlay-build
plugins.description: Native macOS arm64 build overlay for psxrecomp game repos (BloodyRoar2Recomp-style): pull-friendly patch overlay, CMake-pinned dependency fetching, Homebrew-upgrade resilience, per-region targets and setup wizard configs, and the wizard toolchain-pack fix.

plugins.name: hardware-probe-discipline
plugins.description: Probing unknown hardware behaviour (HID reports, peripherals, protocols) with one variant at a time, guaranteed stops, and human confirmation.

plugins.name: macos-sdl3-app-bundle
plugins.description: Package an SDL3 game or tool as a double-clickable macOS .app, or fix a bundle that lost its fonts/art/config: the two asset lookup roots (executable dir vs SDL_GetBasePath), LaunchServices argv/cwd behaviour, TCC identity for HID/Input Monitoring, and what codesign can and cannot seal.

plugins.name: itch-io-download
plugins.description: Download free or owned itch.io uploads via curl: the file endpoint yields the real signed CDN URL, not the download_url HTML interstitial.

plugins.name: unity-mono-lib-only-recomp
plugins.description: Decompile and recompile a Unity Mono game's Assembly-CSharp.dll against the shipped managed libraries into a functionally identical program, no Unity editor; includes macOS CrossOver launch verification.

plugins.name: omp-harness-api-gotchas
plugins.description: Verified OMP/bash API semantics that cause failed tool calls: task tools field expects eval tools, commit namespace is cwd-bound, bash UID is readonly.

plugins.name: unity-no-editor-metal-shader-port
plugins.description: Use when a Unity WINDOWS Mono game must render natively on macOS Metal (or Linux GL) WITHOUT the Unity editor — i.e. the player launches but falls back to NullGfxDevice / crashes because assets carry D3D11-only shaders. Proven on The House On Ash Tree Lane (Unity 2021.1.11f1).

plugins.name: port-fidelity-gap-audit
plugins.description: Use when a ported / recompiled / reverse-engineered build "works" (boots, runs, renders) but may not MATCH the original — systematically audit visual, audio, behavioral and platform fidelity gaps (default post-fx, lighting/lightmaps, texture encoding/color-space, palette textures, shaders, static batching, UI scaling, fonts, physics feel, scene flow) by side-by-side comparison against the original before declaring done.

plugins.name: unity-free-sdl3-rebuild
plugins.description: "Use when removing the Unity engine entirely and running a decompiled Unity Mono game's verbatim C# on a lightweight backend with a much smaller build. Proven on The House On Ash Tree Lane (Unity 2021.1): SDL3 SDL_GPU native Metal + clean-room UnityEngine shim, 855MB→116MB."
